description: This source file defines the `DocumentObjectSnapshot` class used for creating recursive snapshots of document objects and their properties/children for testing and comparison in the MigraDoc library. It includes mechanisms for auto-creating objects, excluding properties from comparison, and deep equality checks of document object states, mainly for testing document structure consistency.

classes.name: DocumentObjectSnapshot
classes.description: A class that captures a detailed snapshot of a DocumentObject's properties, children, and state for testing and comparison purposes. Supports recursive traversal and deep comparison of document object hierarchies.

methods.name: CompareSnapshots
methods.description: Static method that performs a deep comparison of two DocumentObjectSnapshot instances, verifying their equivalence in structure, properties, and children, with detailed path-based reporting.
